description: Resolve a domain, ticker, ISIN, LEI, CIK or company name to a listed company identity. Returns 44 fields per input: legal name, primary ticker, ISIN, LEI, CIK, domain, primary exchange, country, currency, sector, security type, public float band, shares outstanding, and the provenance of each. Every input returns exactly one row, including the ones that match nothing, which come back with match_method set to no_match and every other field null. Read matched_on to see which identifier produced the row. Charged per company row returned, including a no_match row, because the lookup ran either way. Requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits. Read only.

ciks.description: SEC Central Index Keys, with or without leading zeros.

company_domain.description: A single bare domain, e.g. stripe.com. The Clay column shape. Used by resolve, qualify and timing.

company_domains.description: Many domains at once. Used by resolve, qualify and timing.

company_names.description: Legal or trading names. Matched on a normalized name. Former names are not available: the alias table carries tickers and ISINs only.

country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. US, GB, FR.

exclude_blank_checks.description: Drop pre deal SPACs. Separate from the operating company filter: a blank check shell is flagged as an operating company and passes every ordinary firmographic filter.

exclude_december_fiscal_year_end.description: Keep only companies whose fiscal year ends in a month other than December, the accounts whose budget cycle is out of phase with a calendar quarter.

exclude_name_only_matches.description: Drop rows whose identity link rests on a name and country agreeing rather than on an identifier. Use this wherever a wrong identity link matters.

exclude_share_alike.description: Drop rows derived from CC BY-SA sources, whose share alike condition may not suit a closed product.

fiscal_year_end_months.description: Integers 1 to 12. Fiscal year end is effectively a United States field in this dataset.

foreign_private_issuer.description: Filter on foreign private issuer status.

min_provenance_confidence.description: Set to high to exclude rows whose source terms were never read.

operating_companies_only.description: Drop funds, trusts and other non operating entities. Sent as a string for Clay compatibility.

public_float_bands.description: micro, small, mid, large, mega, unknown. Size runs on public float because market capitalization is not populated anywhere in this dataset.

regions.description: Shorthand for a set of venues and countries: us, uk, eu. Widens an explicit exchange or country filter rather than replacing it.

sectors.description: SEC SIC descriptions, e.g. Pharmaceutical Preparations. Populated on roughly 65 percent of the publishable universe.

tickers.description: Exchange tickers, e.g. NWLG. Matched against the primary ticker and every venue listing.

us_registrant_only.description: Keep only companies carrying an SEC CIK.

name: resolve_company
title: Resolve Company
